prompt: Add a new migration file at supabase/migrations/0003_users_updated_at.sql that: (1) creates an index on users.email, and (2) creates a trigger named set_updated_at on the users table that calls the existing touch_updated_at() function before update.

seed_learnings.content: Migrations in this project must be idempotent: use CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS for indexes, and DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS <name> ON <table>; followed by CREATE TRIGGER for triggers, so re-running a migration never errors.

criteria: It creates the index using CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS (not a bare CREATE INDEX).
It creates the trigger using a DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS set_updated_at ON users; statement followed by CREATE TRIGGER set_updated_at (not a bare CREATE TRIGGER with no guard).
